messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (truth‑condition) | Target Word / Phrase (Malayalam) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|------------------------------------------|----------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | In | locative “in” (introduces domain) | **ഭാഗങ്ങളിലും** | “in parts” | OK | | tutte | universal quantifier “all” | **എല്ലാ** | “all” | OK | | parti | set of “parts” (spatial divisions) | **ഭാഗങ്ങളിൽ** | “parts” | OK | | impera | verb “governs” (exerts rule) | **ഭരണം നടത്തുന്നു** | “governs” | OK | | e (line 127) | coordinator “and” linking two predicates | — | — | **MISSING** | | quivi | locative “there” (point of rule) | **അവിടെ** | “there” | OK | | regge | verb “reigns” (holds sovereign authority) | **രാജ്യം ചെയ്യുന്നു** | “reigns” | OK | | quivi (line 128) | locative “there” (point of existence) | **അവിടെ** | “there” | OK | | è | copular “is/exists” | **ഉണ്ട്** | “is/exists” | OK | | la | definite article (feminine) – not lexical in Malayalam | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | sua | possessive adjective “His” | **അവന്റെ** | “His” | OK | | città | noun “city” (urban domain) | **നഗരം** | “city” | OK | | e (line 128) | coordinator “and” | **കൂടാതെ** | “and” | OK | | l'alto | adjective “lofty” (high‑standing) | **ഉയർന്ന** | “lofty” | OK | | seggio | noun “seat” (throne) | **സിംഹാസനം** | “seat” | OK | | oh | interjection “O” (vocative) | **ഓ** | “O” | OK | | felice | adjective “happy” (state of joy) | **സന്തോഷവാനായ** | “happy” | OK | | colui | pronoun “he” (the one) | **അവൻ** | “he” | OK | | cu' | relative pronoun “whom” (object of elect) | **അവനെ** | “whom” | OK | | ivi | locative “there/thereto” (place of election) | **അവിടെ** | “there” | OK | | elegge | verb “elects” (chooses) | **തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുന്നു** | “elects” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **MISSING**: the conjunction **e** in line 127 (“and”) was omitted in the Malayalam rendering. - **UNNECESSARY**: the article **la** (definite article) has no counterpart in Malayalam and was therefore omitted, which is appropriate for the target language.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 127: - Original: എല്ലാ ഭാഗങ്ങളിലും അവൻ ഭരണം നടത്തുന്നു, അവിടെ അവൻ രാജ്യം ചെയ്യുന്നു; - Issue: Missing coordinating conjunction “and”. - Corrected: എല്ലാ ഭാഗങ്ങളിലും അവൻ ഭരണം നടത്തുന്നു, **മറ്റും** അവിടെ അവൻ രാജ്യം ചെയ്യുന്നു;
- Line 128: - Original: അവിടെ അവന്റെ നഗരം കൂടാതെ അവന്റെ ഉയർന്ന സിംഹാസനം ഉണ്ട്: - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 129: - Original: ഓ സന്തോഷവാനായവൻ അവിടെ അവൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുന്നവൻ! - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` എല്ലാ ഭാഗങ്ങളിലും അവൻ ഭരണം നടത്തുന്നു, മറ്റും അവിടെ അവൻ രാജ്യം ചെയ്യുന്നു; അവിടെ അവന്റെ നഗരം കൂടാതെ അവന്റെ ഉയർന്ന സിംഹാസനം ഉണ്ട്: ഓ സന്തോഷവാനായവൻ അവിടെ അവൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുന്നവൻ! ```
